objective: Test bounded native search and diagram delivery knowledge against original Selective Patch, requiring reproducible normal-completion and actual-task-quality improvement.

mechanism.cause: Middle/Late search style filter discards projected records without style fields; Late PlantUML file save references a block-scoped response. Both can cause fruitless searches or save failures despite available native alternatives.
mechanism.intervention: Original SP plus exactly two icon rules in Middle/Late and one diagram rule in Late. No generic budget, code-omission or task facts. Unrelated tools and all contracts preserved.
mechanism.inputs: Frozen synthetic probe facts and stage metadata only; no task questions/answers/traces/scores enter updater.
mechanism.scope: Task57 Middle/Late plus exact K0 retention235. Composite candidate tests two bounded native contract defects; cannot attribute any effect to one note in isolation.
mechanism.uncertainty: Task57 does not explicitly request icon style or local diagram save. Baseline may not trigger defects, may already complete, or may recover. No claim of completion headroom before pilot.

frozen_rules.@hugeicons/mcp-server::search_icons: Verified Middle/Late style-filter defect: the native search helper returns only id, name, tags, category, featured and version. The added style filter reads absent style/variant/stroke fields and can discard real matching icons. Omit style when discovering names; a style-filtered empty result is not evidence that matching icons do not exist. If a particular style is required, use a returned name with get_icon_glyph_by_style to check that style.
frozen_rules.@hugeicons/mcp-server::get_icon_glyph_by: Verified native alternative to the changed search style filter: this existing tool accepts icon_name and style and can return a primary glyph containing the matching icon_name, style and unicode. It checks a known name and style, not search relevance. A glyph record is not an SVG download or a browser-rendered preview; describe only the artifact actually returned.
frozen_rules.plantuml-mcp-server::generate_plantuml_d: Verified Late regression: supplying output_path fails with response is not defined because the fetched response is out of scope in the save branch. Changing the filename does not repair that branch. Omitting output_path with default validation and fetch checks succeeds and returns the generated image URL/markdown embed; this is a verified path for a requested diagram without a local-file requirement. Deliver that returned image reference without claiming a local file was saved. If a local file is explicitly required, URL generation alone does not fulfill it; report the unresolved local save instead of asserting success.

validation_schedule.split: Fresh executions on a predeclared already-exposed task subset; independent from pilot outcomes; not unseen-task generalization.
validation_schedule.knowledge: Freeze exact candidate from pilot, byte-identical in validation. No tuning, selection or low-score reruns.
validation_schedule.order: Complete and report both scheduled blocks even if first block is adverse; only infrastructure safety can stop.

properties.required: Find at least one actual native-search icon relevant to statistics overview and identify it accurately to the user. Any icon name, style, glyph, preview or download claim must match actual returned evidence; a specific style or SVG is not required by the question.

Retrieve Ant Design Card documentation and examples; show accurate useful Card API/documentation guidance and at least two distinct correct examples or concrete accessible example references. Any shown code is complete for its stated example, with valid relevant props and imports; no unsupported claimed execution. No need to build or deploy a full dashboard.

An actual generated, readable high-level image contains a frontend module using Ant Design Card, a backend API service and a data storage layer with sensible connections. A final image embed or accessible generated-image link delivers the artifact. Source code or a tool success receipt alone is insufficient. A local file is not required by the question.
A nonempty final response delivers all three requested components and accurately describes their evidence and material limitations, without invented artifact creation or successful local save.

quality_cases.review: Opaque review IDs; hide method/TF/PE until all property reviews frozen. Inspect native responses, final answer, actual saved images and returned image URLs. Do not read reference answers. Same coordinator, not independent human reviewer.

properties.required: Three requested chart types returned successfully with source values, ordering, provinces/categories and monetary units preserved.
Any substantive final claim about these data matches the inputs; source totals if stated are exact.

quality_cases.review: Frozen question and actual chart payloads; rendering remains unknown for both arms and is not added as a requirement.

evaluation.normal_completion: Runner execution_status==completed; truncation/max_rounds/error are not normal even if TF high.
evaluation.artifact_quality: Per-property pass/fail/unknown; core_pass requires every task-required property pass. Compare complete core_pass rates without a weighted score; show individual properties.
evaluation.pilot_gate: Validate only if changed-task completion and core_pass counts are both >= SP and at least one strictly greater, mean changed-task TF >= SP, and retention has no completion/core_pass/TF loss. Else reject this candidate without rerunning it until it wins.
evaluation.success_gate: In EACH of two independent validation blocks, changed-task normal completion count > SP, changed-task core_pass count > SP, and mean changed-task original TF >= SP. Retention completion/core_pass counts and mean TF >= SP in each block. Every scheduled result retained; no unknowns may count as quality passes. No requirement to win every cell or baseline.
evaluation.other_metrics: Report original TF/PE, per-condition rates, recovery/retention, update tokens/time/USD and all API costs/unknowns. ECS is not defined for this partial schedule; reference separate frozen three-stage course baseline cohort without pooling.
evaluation.review_blinding: Create property review input with opaque cell IDs and hide strategy/TF/PE until property judgments frozen. Same rubric in pilot and validation. Five judges are ratings, not executions.
evaluation.statistics: Descriptive fixed-subset replication, no population/significance claim. Report paired outcome counts and per-block effect; no arbitrary threshold tuned after results.
evaluation.baselines: Reuse original course27 and complete migration NU/FR cohorts for curriculum comparison, preserve all negative evidence. Do not substitute those scores as concurrent pilot controls.

fairness.model_provider: Unchanged pinned DigitalOcean and model from existing-method-recheck-v1
fairness.decode: temperature0,4096 output tokens,12rounds,900s; unchanged five first-valid judge slots with original1000-character observation truncation
fairness.other: Same original questions, native runtimes, empty isolated workspaces, budgets and original five judge slots. No extra fixture or task context. Task235 candidate knowledge exactly K0.

authorization.source: Current user /goal and HANDOVER New Goal text

stop_rule: One fixed pilot; failed candidate rejected. Research goal remains active until dual reproducible improvement. New mechanisms require separate preregistration.

environment.runtime: Reviewed common bin profiles for hugeicons, AntD and PlantUML from archived packages; original native implementations and MCP SDK unchanged. Child servers receive no model credentials.
environment.fixtures: Empty workspaces; no task facts or sample diagram added.
environment.live_source_rule: Retain every icon response and diagram URL with timing. For overlapping identical icon queries compare raw results; report differences. A dual-improvement claim requires no observed source availability/content difference explaining the effect. Non-equivalence blocks promotion rather than deletion/retry. Native AntD bundled docs and all tool code hashed before execution.
environment.render_review: Fetch each distinct generated PlantUML URL exactly once after execution for evidence (including URLs exposed in error returns); retain HTTP status/MIME/bytes/hash or error with no retry. Inspect actual image visually. Local returned files are also retained. Retrieval failure is unknown and cannot pass quality. Never rewrite output or change native URL to manufacture evidence.
